reddit.title: Introducing Ranks That Turn and March in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest devtalk on the mechanics of unit movement in Provincia! Discover how formation drags work, the new rules for attacking from behind, and the removal of teleportation for a more realistic experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
